one_line: Satavahana ruler of the Western Deccan who reversed Khaharata–Śaka power and restored his dynasty’s prestige.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a solid warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, thick eyebrows; a small vertical tilaka mark on the forehead, default expression calm and resolute with a dignified half-frown when serious.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair drawn into a high topknot at the back of the crown, front and sides neatly smoothed; a simple gold circlet-band resting above the forehead and partially hidden by the hair, no elaborate crown.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length reddish-maroon cotton tunic (kurta-like) with short fitted sleeves and a round neckline, bordered at the hem and sleeve edges with narrow gold trim; over this, a pale cream dhoti wrapped tightly around the waist and legs in the Deccan style, pleats falling in front, with a broad mustard-yellow waistband; a long saffron-orange uttariya (shawl) of fine cotton drapes from the left shoulder across the chest and flows behind his back, its edges decorated with a subtle repeating geometric border in dark red; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals; jewelry is restrained—two medium-thick gold armlets on his upper arms, a pair of small gold stud earrings, and a single beaded necklace of gold and dark stone beads, plus a plain gold ring on his right hand; no armor plates, only the cloth and ornaments of an early historic Deccan king.
appearance.signature: A long straight-edged iron sword with a simple slightly flaring bronze hilt and round pommel, worn on his left side in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard; when drawn, he holds it in his right hand with disciplined, upright posture.

ref_desc: Gautamiputra Śātakarṇi is a medium-brown, oval-faced warrior king with a black topknot and gold circlet, wearing a maroon tunic, cream dhoti, saffron shawl, modest gold jewelry and brown sandals, carrying a plain long iron sword in a brown scabbard with maroon, cream, saffron, mustard and gold colors.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Gautamiputra Śātakarṇi as a dignified early historic Deccan king: a medium-brown, oval-faced man in his early thirties with thick black hair tied in a high topknot, a simple gold circlet-band above his forehead, strong brows, straight nose, and a small vertical tilaka on his calm, resolute face. Show his entire outfit clearly: a knee-length reddish-maroon short-sleeved tunic with narrow gold trim at the edges, a tightly wrapped cream dhoti with front pleats and a broad mustard-yellow waistband, and a long saffron-orange cotton shawl (uttariya) draped from the left shoulder across his chest and flowing behind. Include his modest gold armlets, small gold stud earrings, a single beaded gold-and-dark-stone necklace, and a plain gold ring, with his feet in simple brown leather sandals. His one signature weapon is a long straight-edged iron sword with a slightly flaring bronze hilt and round pommel, sheathed at his left side in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard; in some poses he holds it upright in his right hand. Use maroon, cream, saffron orange, mustard yellow, gold, and brown as dominant colors, and show multiple angles to keep the hair, face, garments, jewelry and sword consistent.
